The Steam Mineral Logistics Cluster closes the crossover road: a 15x12x29 main hall (plus 8-deep extension segments) hosting one controller, seven processing units — crusher, ore washer, centrifuge, thermal centrifuge, sifter, magnetic separator, furnace — five amplifiers and a logistics unit. Ore in, products out, whole chains atomic.

The bill: 2,000 L/s steam + 10 L/s lubricant to preheat, then 8,000 x 1.5^(chain length - 1) L/s per processing chain. Amplifiers multiply it — parallel x1.3, speed x1.4, primary x2.0, secondary x1.6, steam saver x1.1 — with primary boosts taking only the highest, secondary boosts adding up, and steam savings capped at 48% total.

Bolt auto-maintenance hatches into the structure and say goodbye to wrench duty. This hall is where Z3's EV and IV lines come to be fed.
